description: This file defines macros, structures, and function prototypes for configuring and controlling GPIO pins on Cypress PSoC-6 MCUs within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: soc_gpio_configure
methods.description: Configures one or multiple GPIO pins based on provided configuration data.

methods.name: soc_gpio_list_configure
methods.description: Configures a list of GPIO pins with specified configurations.
